diagnostics.title: The request is not in the shape Lite expects
diagnostics.explanation: A request to Lite is missing a field or holds a wrong one: for example the list of hashes is longer than the number of files of a project or a hash is not a SHA-256 in lower case hexadecimal, or the body of a build or a share does not have its fields (entry and files; code and action). (HTTP 400)
diagnostics.wrongExample: {"hashes": ["not-a-hash"]}

diagnostics.title: The project has no files
diagnostics.explanation: A Lite project needs at least one file. (HTTP 400)
diagnostics.wrongExample: A build with an empty list of files.
diagnostics.rightExample: A build with the song and its files.

diagnostics.title: The project has too many files
diagnostics.explanation: A Lite project has at most as many files as the limit of the server says (the message shows the number). (HTTP 413)
diagnostics.wrongExample: A project with more files than the limit.

diagnostics.title: A file is in the project twice
diagnostics.explanation: Every path of the project can be there once. (HTTP 400)
diagnostics.wrongExample: songs/a.amplet twice in the list of files.

diagnostics.title: This kind of file is not allowed
diagnostics.explanation: A Lite project can hold only a few kinds of file (the message lists them by extension). (HTTP 400)
diagnostics.wrongExample: A file with an extension that is not on the list.
diagnostics.rightExample: Files with an extension from the list.

diagnostics.title: The file is too large
diagnostics.explanation: A file is larger than the limit for its kind (audio, sound font or other); the message shows the size and the limit. (HTTP 413)
diagnostics.wrongExample: An audio file above the limit.
diagnostics.rightExample: An audio file below the limit.

diagnostics.title: The project is too large
diagnostics.explanation: The files of the project together are larger than the limit of a Lite project; the message shows both in megabytes. (HTTP 413)
diagnostics.wrongExample: A project of more megabytes than the limit.

diagnostics.title: The song to build must be a .amplet file
diagnostics.explanation: The entry of a build has to name a song file, with the extension .amplet. (HTTP 400)
diagnostics.wrongExample: entry: "notes.txt"

diagnostics.title: The song to build is not in the project
diagnostics.explanation: The entry of the build names a file that is not among the files of the project. (HTTP 400)
diagnostics.wrongExample: entry: "other.amplet" when the files are song.amplet only.

diagnostics.title: The path of a file is not valid
diagnostics.explanation: A path must be a plain relative path (use / between names), not deeper than the limit of folders, with names of letters, digits, space, dot, dash and underscore that start with a letter or a digit and are not longer than the limit. (HTTP 400)
diagnostics.wrongExample: ../song.amplet or a name with a colon.

diagnostics.title: The song asks for a capability that Lite does not give
diagnostics.explanation: Lite does not give the capabilities environment, network, filesystem, external-process and external-plugin. A song that asks for one is refused. (HTTP 400)
diagnostics.wrongExample: A song with a policy that grants network.

diagnostics.title: The block needs a plugin or an AI model
diagnostics.explanation: Lite has no plugins and no AI models. A block that needs one (for example an AI voice) is refused. (HTTP 400)
diagnostics.wrongExample: An ai-voice block.
diagnostics.rightExample: Blocks that run on Lite: instruments, effects, mixers.

diagnostics.title: A sound bank or a path is not available in Lite
diagnostics.explanation: The song names a sound bank that Lite does not have (there is one shared bank), a file name that is empty, or a path that points outside the project: Lite only reads the files of the project. (HTTP 400)
diagnostics.wrongExample: A path outside the project, or another sound bank.
diagnostics.rightExample: A file of the project, or the shared bank.

diagnostics.title: A block of the song did not build
diagnostics.explanation: The build of one of the blocks failed or was skipped; the message names the block, what happened to it and the reason. The paths of the workspace are removed from the text.
diagnostics.wrongExample: A block with a parameter that cannot be built.

diagnostics.title: The song makes no sound
diagnostics.explanation: The song has no master block that listens to something, so there is no audio to give back.
diagnostics.wrongExample: A song without a master block.
diagnostics.rightExample: A song with a master that has an input.

diagnostics.title: The song is too long
diagnostics.explanation: Lite builds at most as many seconds as the limit says; the message shows the length of the song and the limit.
diagnostics.wrongExample: A song of 10 minutes.

diagnostics.title: The build took too long
diagnostics.explanation: The build took longer than the time that Lite gives it and was stopped.
diagnostics.wrongExample: A song with heavy blocks.

diagnostics.title: Lite is busy
diagnostics.explanation: Too many builds are waiting, or your build waited the whole time without getting a turn. Try again in a minute (the answer says how long to wait). (HTTP 429)
diagnostics.wrongExample: Sending a build while many are waiting.
diagnostics.rightExample: Trying again after the time in Retry-After.

diagnostics.title: The build failed inside Lite
diagnostics.explanation: Something went wrong in Lite itself. The message gives a reference that can be used to find it in the log of the server. (HTTP 500)
diagnostics.wrongExample: Not a mistake of the song.
diagnostics.rightExample: Try again; give the reference when asking for help.

diagnostics.title: The download limit of the hour is reached
diagnostics.explanation: One address can download a limited amount of encoded audio (MP3 or FLAC) in an hour; the message shows what was used, the limit and when to try again. (HTTP 429)
diagnostics.wrongExample: Downloading more than the limit in an hour.

diagnostics.title: A build is already running or waiting
diagnostics.explanation: There is one build at a time for the same user. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it first. (HTTP 429)
diagnostics.wrongExample: Starting a second build.
diagnostics.rightExample: Waiting for the first to finish.

diagnostics.title: The format is not known
diagnostics.explanation: The format of a download must be wav, mp3 or flac. (HTTP 400)
diagnostics.wrongExample: format: "ogg"

diagnostics.title: MP3 and FLAC are not available on this server
diagnostics.explanation: The server has no encoder installed; the WAV download always works. (HTTP 503)
diagnostics.wrongExample: format: "mp3" on a server without an encoder.

diagnostics.title: The encoded file would be too large
diagnostics.explanation: The result of the encoding is larger than Lite allows. (HTTP 413)
diagnostics.wrongExample: A long song as FLAC.
diagnostics.rightExample: A shorter song or the WAV.

diagnostics.title: Encoding took too long
diagnostics.explanation: The encoding took longer than the time it gets and was stopped. (HTTP 504)
diagnostics.wrongExample: A very long song.

diagnostics.title: The encoder could not convert this audio
diagnostics.explanation: The encoder stopped with an error or gave an empty file. (HTTP 500)
diagnostics.wrongExample: Not a mistake of the song.

diagnostics.title: The build needed too much memory
diagnostics.explanation: The build used more memory than the limit and was stopped. Make the song smaller. (HTTP 413)
diagnostics.wrongExample: A song with too many or too large sounds.

diagnostics.title: Some files are no longer on the server
diagnostics.explanation: Lite keeps the files that were sent for an hour. Send the build or the share again with all files. (HTTP 409)
diagnostics.wrongExample: Building from hashes after an hour.

diagnostics.title: A file does not match its hash
diagnostics.explanation: A file that was sent with a SHA-256 hash has other content than the hash says. (HTTP 400)
diagnostics.wrongExample: A file and a hash of another file.
diagnostics.rightExample: The hash of the file that is sent.

diagnostics.title: The hourly limit for sharing is reached
diagnostics.explanation: One address can share only a limited number of megabytes of its own files in an hour; the message shows the size and the limit. (HTTP 413)
diagnostics.wrongExample: Sharing more than the limit in an hour.

diagnostics.title: The details of the share are not valid
diagnostics.explanation: A share needs details of the right kind, for example a title and an author. (HTTP 400)
diagnostics.wrongExample: A share without a title.
diagnostics.rightExample: A share with a title and an author.

diagnostics.title: Sharing is not available for a moment
diagnostics.explanation: The store of shares is full. Try again later. (HTTP 503)
diagnostics.wrongExample: Sharing while the store is full.

diagnostics.title: This share does not exist
diagnostics.explanation: There is no share with this code, or the secret does not belong to it. (HTTP 404)
diagnostics.wrongExample: A link to a share that was never made.
diagnostics.rightExample: A link that was given out.

diagnostics.title: This share is no longer available
diagnostics.explanation: The share has expired or was deleted (the answer is 410), or a file that was asked for is not in the share (404). (HTTP 410)
diagnostics.wrongExample: Opening a link after the share expired.
diagnostics.rightExample: Opening a link while the share is available.
